The Open Door Notes (1899–1900, John Hay) asked the great powers to keep China open to trade on equal terms, so the US wouldn't be shut out of any sphere of influence. Of the options, C is the closest fit: it covers US trade access, though "missionaries" is a looser addition. The team note's other candidate (immigration) is wrong, since the notes were about commerce, not immigration.

The answer is C.

CONFIDENCE: 88
